name: Form Process Quality Control (Web)
implementation_notes: The Process Quality Control Detail grid is fully dynamic -- addDetailRow()/removeDetailRow()/canAddRow()/availableTimeSlotOptions() on FormProcessQualityControl.php, exactly mirroring FormClarification's grid. Grid starts empty on create mode; edit mode loads existing rows verbatim with each row's id

All 16 non-time_slot columns per row are genuinely editable, never disabled -- Process Quality Control has no computed detail-grid fields and NO enum dropdowns at all: 12 are numeric inputs, 4 (Shift, QC Inspector ID, QC Engineering Corrective Actions, Findings) are plain text inputs -- the widest form grid in the project (min-width: 2600px)
UNLIKE Form Threshing Web: this screen has NO operational-target reference table section -- no query, no reference data of any kind
Route /data/process-quality-control/create registered BEFORE /data/process-quality-control/{id} (screen-110) so the literal 'create' segment is not swallowed by {id}
checked/acknowledged self-attestation checkboxes mirror FormClarification's dual-checkbox pattern (both Checked By AND Acknowledged By)
NoActiveProcessQualityControlStationException (mirrors NoActiveClarificationStationException) thrown when production_line_id has no active station type=process-quality-control

This is the FINAL screen of the FINAL (10th) station implemented in this project -- all 10 stations from the 2026-08-31 batch (Solid Waste Disposal, Process Water, Kernel Dispatch, CPO Dispatch, Effluent Plant, Storage Tank, Engine Room, Boiler Room, Clarification, Process Quality Control) are now fully implemented end-to-end (mobile + web) with all Data Browser tiles routed on Production Process Activity

known_issues.description: Browser (Playwright) spec (backend/tests/Browser/FormProcessQualityControlTest.php) exists following this codebase's established convention but could not be executed in this sandboxed environment -- integration (Feature/Api) and component (Feature/Livewire) coverage is complete and passing, consistent with the codebase's Browser/* convention.
